props.gloss_en: Rav Kahana: [Sinai is] a mountain on which miracles were done for Israel
Rav Kahana, revising: a mountain that became a good sign for Israel
Rav Chisda and Rabba son of Rav Huna: what is Har Sinai? a mountain on which hatred (sin'a) descended upon the nations of the world
R' Yosei b'R' Chanina: it has five names -- Midbar Tzin, for Israel were commanded (nitztavu) on it
Midbar Kadesh, for Israel were sanctified (nitkadshu) on it
Midbar Kedemot, for a primordial thing (keduma) was given on it
Midbar Paran, for Israel were fruitful (paru) and multiplied on it
Midbar Sinai, for hatred (sin'a) descended upon the nations of the world on it
R' Yosei b'R' Chanina: and what is its name? Horeb is its name
R' Abbahu: Har Sinai is its name
R' Abbahu: and why is it called Har Horeb? for destruction (churba) descended upon the nations of the world on it

objections.gloss_en: הר ניסאי מיבעי ליה! -- if it were named for miracles it would be called Har Nisai
הר סימנאי מיבעי ליה! -- if it were named for a sign it would be called Har Simanai
